## Evidence: **the docs already publish both halves of this contradiction**

Measured by the `domain:services` seat while dispositioning the docs-drift advisory on PR #11659 (the #11507 declaration half). Read with `git show <sha>:<path>` on `18516c39950712c13ff1c35468757aae0df61243` — the merge commit that CI's `pull_request` checkout actually read — not from the shared working tree, which is a different and unknown state.

This does not change the finding. It raises its severity from "a closed type in spec" to "**a closed contract already rendered and shipped to authors**", and it hands the spec seat a second file that moves with whichever option is chosen.

### `content/docs/references/data/feed.mdx` publishes `FeedItemType` as an authoritative allow-list

That page is **auto-generated** from `packages/spec/src/data/feed.zod.ts` (`⚠️ AUTO-GENERATED — DO NOT EDIT. Run build-docs.ts to regenerate.`), and it renders the enum under the literal heading **`### Allowed Values`**, all 13 members bulleted. So the closed map is not only a type an author might hit at build time — it is documentation telling an author, in the platform's own reference, that these are the values that exist.

⇒ Whichever of options 1/2/3 is taken, **this page moves with it automatically** on the next `build-docs.ts` run. Worth naming in the card so nobody hand-edits it: it is generated, and a hand-edit would be silently undone.

### The contradiction is published side by side

`content/docs/references/data/object.mdx:133` (also auto-generated) documents the sanctioned author channel:

| **activityMilestones** | `{ field: string; value: string; summary: string; type?: string }[]` | optional | … (ADR-0052 §5b.2) |

So today, in the same docs set: **`object.mdx` tells an author the activity type is an open `string`**, and **`feed.mdx` tells the same author the activity kinds are 13 named values.** Both are accurate about their own file and they cannot both be a complete account of the vocabulary. That is this finding in its sharpest published form.

### One stale framing claim, for whoever takes the card

`feed.mdx`'s generated preamble (from the source module's docblock) still says these enums are

> pure UI configuration for the record activity component (`RecordActivityProps` …), **with no backend dependency**

After the 2026-08-24 ruling that is misleading in a load-bearing way: `FeedItemType` is the **target of a map from a backend column** (`sys_activity.type`) whose vocabulary is now open by ruling. The enum has no backend *import*, but it does have a backend *coupling*, and that coupling is exactly what this card is about. The sentence lives in the spec source docblock, so it is the spec seat's to correct — flagged, ⛔ not touched.

### Not measured (unchanged from the card)

Still open: whether any shipped app authors `record:activity` `types` at all, and what the objectui renderer does with an unknown value today. Neither is reachable from this repo, and the second is the one that decides whether the filter gap is real or theoretical — which is why the card's own recommendation to let the objectui consumer card land first still looks right to me. ⛔ I am not ranking options 1/2/3; that remains the spec seat's judgement.
